messages:
Maria (AE): Heads-up: Jules from MetroBank wants a hands-on POC. Scope: dedicated/Dedicated-like setup with VPC peering, streaming API to push trade alerts, strict schema enforcement (JSON), and server-initiated function-calls to ack receipts. They also need a short pricing sketch for sustained streams and answers to the security questionnaire. Any immediate red flags?

Jules (FinOps): Our main constraint is predictable egress IPs and encryption at rest with CMK. We also need the event JSON to be exactly reproducible (no floats turning into strings). POC duration ~10 business days.

Lena (Presales): Good to know. My plan: a Dedicated POC instance with limited capacity (2 nodes) and a sample integration repo. Omar, can your team provide a small SDK example for streaming + server-side function calls that shows assembly of fragmented frames?

Omar (SE): Yep. We should pick HTTP/2 server push for demo (easier to firewall) or websockets if they want long-lived bi-directional. Example snippet (python):
```py
# simplified streaming + function handler
with client.stream_chat(model='redwood-rw-2', messages=[{"role":"user","content":"emit trade"}], functions=[{"name":"ack","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"trade_id":{"type":"string"}}}}]) as s:
    for event in s.events():
        if event.type=='function_call':
            payload = json.loads(event.payload)
            # validate payload against schema then call downstream ack endpoint
            requests.post(EXTERNAL_ACK_URL, json=payload)
        elif event.type=='token':
            buffer.append(event.text)
```
I'll add guidance about reassembling arguments and idempotency for retries.

Carl (Eng): Infrastructure notes: Dedicated POC can have a stable egress IP block. We will enable customer-managed KMS when we stand up the private stack. One caveat: numeric precision can be affected by the tokenizer; recommend emitting numbers as JSON numbers using a post-process step on our side if they need deterministic formatting. No infra blockers otherwise.

Priya (Security): For the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 attestations, data residency details, and an optional scoped Private deployment for the POC. I'll need their security lead contact and SAML metadata for SSO test accounts. Also: we can supply an allowlist of 5 egress IPs for the Dedicated POC. Hosted sandbox won't meet strict allowlist needs.

Jules (FinOps): Sending contact: security@metrobank.com and SAML entity id later today. Also please include an SLA for the POC window and an on-call contact for any incidents.

Maria (AE): Action list:
- Omar: create sample repo + short README with reassembly and idempotency notes (today)
- Lena: prepare 10-day POC runbook and coordinate access for MetroBank (tomorrow)
- Carl: produce egress IP list and CMK setup notes (EOD)
- Priya: fill security questionnaire and share SOC2 + SAML onboarding steps (tomorrow)
- Sam (cc): draft a pricing sketch: token estimates + per-connection minute for long-lived streams, include Dedicated incremental cost (tomorrow)

Omar (SE): Sample repo pushed: https://internal.redwood/presales/metrobank-streaming-sample (private). It contains examples for HTTP/2 and websocket approaches, and a tiny JSON schema validator.

Priya (Security): I've uploaded a redacted SOC2 summary and the standard answers doc to the workspace. Also booking a short call with MetroBank sec team for tomorrow 9am PT.

Carl (Eng): Egress IPs for the POC (prelim): 35.204.11.12, 35.204.11.13, 35.204.11.14, 35.204.11.15, 35.204.11.16. Will confirm once env is provisioned.

Jules (FinOps): Thanks. Can you also confirm whether callbacks will include ClientCert TLS mutual auth? We prefer mTLS.

Priya (Security): We can enable mTLS for callback endpoints in Dedicated or Private. We'll include config steps in the runbook.

Maria (AE): Scheduling: target POC start 2026-04-12. If security call goes well, we can provision the Dedicated POC the week prior. Anyone blocked on that date?

Lena (Presales): No blockers from my side. I'll lock the calendar once MetroBank confirms.

Jules (FinOps): Confirmed tentative. Thanks all.
